analysis:
Integration of all nine units. The PR contains docs (docs/architecture/inference.md hunk at head ~2172-2184), a changelog fragment, an mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer bump (889fe3c to cbaf4cc, no visible diff), an exact-ID addition of RecursiveSI/flint-int4 to the auto-paged list (EngineV2KVBackendPolicy.swift ~38-41), new maskCacheKey/allowsChainedDecode on FlintNativeProtocolConstraint (head ~148-162) and FlintAnswerStopConstraint (head ~70-91), and tests.

Verified from the replayed source:
- Mask keys are sound on the constraint side. The native constraint returns the state id only when not exhausted, remainingTokens > 0 and the state is known. Interned ids are not reused, and the mask depends on the budget only through remainingTokens > 0. The answer-stop constraint returns -1 for matched nodes and reuses the base key for scanning nodes, with key >= 0 enforced. Exhausted or unknown states return nil, so they are not cached and fail closed.
- Keys are state-only and hold no prompt or tenant data. Nothing is persisted to disk, so the T-041 SSD tier (HMAC names, salt scoping, TTL) is untouched. No keys, attestation, wire contract, authorization or crypto code changed.
- The paged-list addition is an exact-string match. The kill switch, VLM veto and crash-loop guard are unchanged. The wider default concurrency (8 on M5 Pro/Max/Ultra) is an availability/capacity matter (T-029, T-010) that depends on existing memory admission, which is not in the supplied evidence.

Unverified contracts and coverage limits:
- The sampler-side chained decode, the redraw logic and the device mask cache live in the mlx-swift-lm submodule bump, which has no visible diff. Whether the cache is per-request or shared, whether the RNG and penalty state is restored on redraw, and the byte-identical-output claim are all unverified. The submodule bump is a supply-chain-relevant change that needs a separate review of the SDK diff, including residual GPU data (T-028) and any cache-storage or memory changes.
- 24 replay units were omitted, and the base FlintNativeProtocolConstraint internals were not fully supplied.

No concrete regression is established from the visible evidence, so findings is empty. needs_deeper_review is true because of the unreviewed submodule content.
